description: This file provides localization data for the Date.js library specifically for the Spanish (Mexico) region, including calendar formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing, and date manipulation functions customized for this locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time components of a Date object to the current time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same time value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current Date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two Date objects are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day given its name in various forms.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month of a year.
